title: 内化未来：一种统一的世界模型规划智能体训练范式
summary: 提出一种三阶段训练范式，使LLM智能体内化世界模型，实现前瞻性规划。通过世界模型智能体中训练、格式引导监督微调和前瞻条件强化学习，弥合格式-能力差距，在搜索和数学推理任务上优于基线方法。
summary_en: Proposes a three-stage training paradigm to internalize world models in LLM agents for foresight planning. Bridges the format-capability gap via World Model Agentic Mid-Training, Format-Eliciting SFT, and Foresight-Conditioned RL, outperforming baselines on search and math reasoning tasks.
